bear_assumptions: USD 11.0 billion revenue, 30% operating margin, 20% normalized tax, 30x after-tax operating earnings, USD 8.6255 billion net financial assets and 360 million diluted shares; procedure and placement growth slows while tariff, hospital-budget, competition and dilution pressure persist.
base_assumptions: USD 11.5 billion revenue, 32% operating margin, 20% normalized tax, 38x after-tax operating earnings, USD 8.6255 billion net financial assets and 358 million diluted shares; procedure-linked recurring revenue remains durable while stock compensation stays in GAAP expense.
bull_assumptions: USD 12.0 billion revenue, 34% operating margin, 20% normalized tax, 45x after-tax operating earnings, USD 8.6255 billion net financial assets and 356 million diluted shares; da Vinci 5 and Ion adoption sustain high-end growth and operating leverage while dilution moderates.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a fresh scenario set clears expected-return, base-return, bear/base, expected/bear and margin-of-safety gates at the then-current price while procedure growth, recurring revenue, operating leverage, clinical trust and per-share cash conversion remain sound; downgrade the thesis if utilization, hospital economics, safety, competition, margins or dilution-adjusted cash conversion deteriorates.
